# Card r1-c-3: Rolling Slam stun lock

## Brainstorm half

### Identity

- Class: Warrior

### Pitch

- Name: Rolling Slam stun lock
- Why pick it: Heavy stuns keep rares still while the aftershock lands.
- How it clears: Slam the pack; stunned monsters stay in the aftershock.
- Bosses: Stun buildup pins a boss for the burst.
- Needs: stun nodes; online at level 20; no respec; cheap
- The catch: Bosses resist stun.
- Playstyle: melee, one-button, boss
